summary: PostgreSQL migration verification testing. All 14 backend API tests pass after fixing: (1) token key in tests (was access_token, is token), (2) meeting create field (meeting_date → date), (3) JSONB attendees string parsing in GET /api/meetings/ list endpoint. All critical flows verified working.

minor.issue: attendees field returned as JSON string not parsed list — asyncpg JSONB returned as raw string in dict(row). FIXED by adding json.loads() parse in list_meetings handler in /app/backend/routers/meetings.py

issues: Uses browser's native datetime-local input (line 'Date & Time' with value '08/01/2026, 06:15 PM') instead of a shadcn calendar component

action_items: Consider replacing browser native datetime-local picker in New Meeting form with a shadcn calendar/date-time component for design consistency
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/meetings/ (list_meetings): asyncpg JSONB columns (attendees, recording_events, paused_periods, shared_with) returned as strings when using SELECT * + dict(row). Fixed by json.loads() in the router. Similar pattern may exist in other routers that do dict(row) on meetings rows — check routers that fetch meetings rows without going through get_meeting().
GET /api/meetings/{id} (get_meeting): Line 148 does `for a in (meeting.get('attendees') or [])` — if attendees is still a string here this would also fail. Should add json.loads guard there too.
Recommend a central `parse_meeting_row(row)` utility to normalize all JSONB fields to avoid future regressions

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all key flows working, minor design issue with native date picker

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed meetings via API during recording flow tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: PostgreSQL migration is stable. All 14 tests pass. Key fix was in GET /api/meetings/ - JSONB attendees was returned as string, fixed with json.loads. Standards (63 items), team insights (matrix key), prep context (supervisees list), portfolio, doc-uploads all working. Recording start/stop flow works. Super admin orgs endpoint works with correct user_count. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_pg_migration.py
rca_of_issue: Root cause: asyncpg returns JSONB columns as Python strings when fetched via SELECT * into asyncpg Record and converted with dict(row). The fix in create_meeting correctly passes Python list objects directly as JSONB (not json.dumps), but the read path in list_meetings returned raw string. Fixed by adding json.loads() for known JSONB fields in the list endpoint response.
